tasks.title: Install and build the tooling
tasks.evidence: npm ci and npm run build passed (supplied install/build log).

tasks.title: Choose the completion mode
tasks.acceptance: Owner selects immediate or timed completion.

tasks.title: Implement the recipe
tasks.acceptance: One player completes the recipe and receives its goods; also intercity freight and regional retail.

tasks.title: Build the browser controls
tasks.acceptance: The browser starts the recipe and shows progress; also employment, payroll and native app distribution.

tasks.title: Observe the controls on a phone
tasks.acceptance: The owner starts a recipe on a phone and sees it complete.
